test('Two new detours preserve the five original rail IDs and valid geometric endpoints',()=>{assert.equal(RAILS.length,15);for(const id of['glassline','copperline','sunline','crossline','homeline','gale-loop','spire-fork'])assert.ok(RAILS.some(r=>r.id===id));});
test('Enemies differ in health, silhouette type and attack cadence; target does not fire',()=>{const s=createState();assert.equal(new Set(s.drones.map(b=>b.kind)).size,9);const heavy=s.drones.find(b=>b.kind==='heavy'),scout=s.drones.find(b=>b.kind==='scout');assert.ok(heavy.hp>scout.hp*2);Object.assign(s.p,{x:14,y:0,z:0});run(s,3);assert.equal(s.bullets.length,0);});
